name: Cube Ala-Eh III 2018

venue.name: Mataas na Kahoy Municipal Hall, Poblacion
venue.address: 414 V. Templo St, Mataas Na Kahoy, Batangas, Philippines
venue.details: Venue will be inside the Municipal Gym

information:
Welcome! This is the third iteration of Cube Ala-eh.

Registration fee is at 300php for the first 3 events. Additional 50php will be implemented per extra event thereon. Payment-first basis will be implemented for competitors coming from the Philippines. Payment details will be emailed to the participants within 24hrs after pre-registration
